'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Grant B DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Grant B]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Grant-Irish
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
